title: Maƙasudin riba, P&L na wata-wata da tsabar kuɗi

say: Makasudin riba, riba da asarar ku na wata-wata, da kwararar kuɗi.
Wannan bidiyon ne don Module 3 na Farashi, Tsararraki da Tsare-tsaren Riba.

Break-har yana gaya muku yadda za ku daina asarar kuɗi. Manufar riba ta gaya muku yadda ake samun kuɗin da kuke so. Kawai ƙara ribar da kuke so a ƙayyadaddun farashin ku, sannan ku raba ta hanyar gudunmawarku kowace raka'a.

card.title: Yi aiki da baya daga ribar da kuke so

say: Kayyade farashin Ngozi Naira 110,000 ne a wata. Ladan nata ya riga ya shiga cikinsu.

cards.d: An ƙidaya azaman tallace-tallace a cikin P&L, amma babu kuɗi da ya isa har sai abokin ciniki ya biya.
Kun biya tsabar kuɗi don yin shi, amma har yanzu ba farashi ba ne a cikin P&L.

say: Ngozi ta samu ribar naira 115,200. To ina kudinta yake?
Dillalan dillalan ta ne kawai ya shigo, Naira 442,000, Naira 84,000 na babban kanti bai isa ba sai wata mai zuwa.
An fitar da Naira 466,000 na batches 7, kayyade farashi da kuma biyan bashin.

say: Kuɗinta ya faɗi zuwa Naira 16,000, bai isa ko da buɗaɗɗen Naira 47,000 ba. Shi ya sa kuke hasashen tsabar kuɗi mako zuwa mako, kuma ku yi aiki da wuri a kowane mako da ya ƙare mara kyau.

card.title: Riba, amma karancin kuɗi

say: Ɗauki ajiya, misali kashi 50, kafin fara oda na al'ada. Ba da daraja kawai ga sanannun kwastomomi, a rubuce, tare da ranar ƙarshe. Ajiye ajiyar aƙalla wata ɗaya na tsayayyen farashi.
Kada ku rance don biyan hasara. Kuma ku yi hankali da saka hannun jari yana ba da lada mai girma na kowane wata.

panel.heading: Kare kuɗin ku
items: Yi ajiya akan oda na al'ada
Rubuta adadin kiredit da kwanan watan da ya gabata
Ajiye tsayayyen farashi na wata ɗaya a matsayin maƙalli
Kada ku taɓa rance don ɓoye hasara
Ka guje wa tayin saka hannun jari mai yawa

say: Don tunawa. Ƙara maƙasudin ribar ku zuwa ƙayyadaddun farashi kuma raba ta hanyar gudummawa. Juya shi zuwa lambar yau da kullun. Gina P&L kowane wata. Ka tuna cewa riba ba tsabar kudi ba ce. Kuma kintace tsabar kudi mako-mako, don haka ku yi aiki kafin mako guda ya tafi mara kyau.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Raka'a don manufa = (kafaffen + riba) / gudummawa
Juya manufa zuwa lambobin yau da kullun
Tallace-tallace, rage COGS, rage kashe kuɗi = ribar riba
Riba ba tsabar kuɗi ba ce: bashi, hannun jari da lamuni
Hasashen kuɗi na mako-mako; yi aiki akan makonni mara kyau

say: Yanzu saita maƙasudin ribar ku tare da lambobi na yau da kullun da na mako-mako, shirya ribar da asarar watan da ya gabata, da gina hasashen tsabar kuɗi na mako huɗu.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukanku na wannan tsarin
items: Sanya maƙasudin riba na ku
Shirya P&L na watan da ya gabata
